ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Download From File-Sharing Website Via Bitsadmin
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file from a suspicious domain

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bitsadmin\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/transfer\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/addfile\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.githubusercontent\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*anonfiles\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cdn\\\.discordapp\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ddns\\\.net.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dl\\\.dropboxusercontent\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ghostbin\\\.co.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*glitch\\\.me.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*gofile\\\.io.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hastebin\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mediafire\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mega\\\.nz.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*onrender\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pages\\\.dev.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*paste\\\.ee.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pastebin\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pastebin\\\.pl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pastetext\\\.net.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*privatlab\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*privatlab\\\.net.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*send\\\.exploit\\\.in.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sendspace\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*storage\\\.googleapis\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*storjshare\\\.io.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*supabase\\\.co.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*temp\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*transfer\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*trycloudflare\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ufile\\\.io.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*w3spaces\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*workers\\\.dev.*")))
